The hand landmark model is obtained from the model link in Google's Hand Landmarker guide, accessed 2026-09-06:
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/latest/hand_landmarker.task
Model card (license and limitations): https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20Hand%20Tracking%20(Lite_Full)%20with%20Fairness%20Oct%202021.pdf
Bundled artifacts are unmodified. They load only when the user explicitly starts local hand tracking. Camera video is not sent to Google or a backend.
